21232-the-hawthorns-a-story-about-childr.creator: Amy Walton
21232-the-hawthorns-a-story-about-childr.description: A book by Amy Walton. t of the nursery window and watched the pear-tree blossom, and the sparrows build their nests, and the pears fall; but by the time this story begins, four of them, whose names were Penelope, Ambrose, Nancy, and David, were schoolroom children, and learnt lessons of Miss Grey down-stairs.

21619-the-tale-of-nimble-deer.title: (Trademark Registered)
21619-the-tale-of-nimble-deer.creator: Unknown
21619-the-tale-of-nimble-deer.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. When Nimble's mother first looked at him she couldn't believe she would ever be able to raise him. He was such a tiny, frail, spotted thing that he seemed too delicate for a life of adventure on the wooded ridges and in the tangled swamps under the shadow of Blue Mountain.

arxiv-2109-14295.title: BEdgeHealth: A Decentralized Architecture for Edge-based IoMT Networks Using Blockchain Thanks: *Part of this work has been accepted at the IEEE Global Communications Conference (GLOBECOM), Taiwan, 2020 [ 1 ] . Thanks: Dinh C. Nguyen is with School of Engineering, Deakin University, Waurn Ponds, VIC
arxiv-2109-14295.creator: Dinh C. Nguyen, Pubudu N. Pathirana
arxiv-2109-14295.description: Abstract The healthcare industry has witnessed significant transformations in e-health services by using mobile edge computing (MEC) and blockchain to facilitate healthcare operations. Many MEC-blockchain-based schemes have been proposed, but some critical technical challenges still remain, such as low quality of services (QoS), data privacy and system security vulnerabilities.

arxiv-2303-11832.title: A generalization of van der Corput’s difference theorem with applications to recurrence and multiple ergodic averages
arxiv-2303-11832.creator: \gname Sohail \sname Farhangi
arxiv-2303-11832.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by \gname Sohail \sname Farhangi. We prove a generalization of van der Corput’s difference theorem for sequences of vectors in a Hilbert space. This generalization is obtained by establishing a connection between sequences of vectors in the first Hilbert space with a vector in a new Hilbert space whose spectral type with respect to a certain unitary operator is absolutely continuous with respect to the Lebesgue measure.

arxiv-2304-06062.title: Quantum Phases in the Honeycomb-Lattice J 1 J_{1} – J 3 J_{3} Ferro-Antiferromagnetic Model: Supplemental Material
arxiv-2304-06062.creator: Shengtao Jiang (gbsn蒋晟韬), Steven R. White, A. L. Chernyshev
arxiv-2304-06062.description: Abstract I phase boundaries from the DMRG scans Here we illustrate how we determine the approximate phase boundaries and corresponding error bars from the DMRG scans. In Figure S1 , we show the in-plane, |\langle S^{x}_{i}\rangle| , and out-of-plane, |\langle S^{z}_{i}\rangle| , ordered moments along the DMRG J_{3} -scan in Fig. 2(b) of the main text.

arxiv-2306-00163.title: Wavefront error of PHI/HRT on Solar Orbiter at various heliocentric distances
arxiv-2306-00163.creator: F. Kahil, A. Gandorfer, J. Hirzberger, D. Calchetti, J. Sinjan, G. Valori, S.K. Solanki, M. Van Noort, K. Albert, N. Albelo Jorge, A. Alvarez-Herrero, T. Appourchaux, L.R. Bellot Rubio, J. Blanco Rodríguez, A. Feller, B. Fiethe, D. Germerott, L. Gizon, L. Guerrero, P. Gutierrez-Marques, M. Kolleck,
arxiv-2306-00163.description: Abstract Aims. We use wavefront sensing to characterise the image quality of the the High Resolution Telescope (HRT) of the Polarimetric and Helioseismic Imager (SO/PHI) data products during the second remote sensing window of the Solar Orbiter’s (SO) nominal mission phase.

arxiv-2307-09284.title: The Chow ring of the moduli space of degree 2 2 quasi-polarized K3 surfaces
arxiv-2307-09284.creator: Samir Canning, Dragos Oprea, Rahul Pandharipande
arxiv-2307-09284.description: Abstract . We study the Chow ring with rational coefficients of the moduli space ℱ 2 \mathcal{F}_{2} of quasi-polarized K ​ 3 K3 surfaces of degree 2 2 . We find generators, relations, and calculate the Chow Betti numbers. The highest nonvanishing Chow group is 𝖠 17 ​ ( ℱ 2 ) ≅ ℚ \mathsf{A}^{17}(\mathcal{F}_{2})\cong{\mathbb{Q}} .

arxiv-2312-13223.title: StableKD: Breaking Inter-block Optimization Entanglement for Stable Knowledge Distillation
arxiv-2312-13223.creator: Shiu-hong Kao, Jierun Chen, S.H. Gary Chan
arxiv-2312-13223.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Shiu-hong Kao, Jierun Chen, S.H. Gary Chan. Knowledge distillation (KD) has been recognized as an effective tool to compress and accelerate models. However, current KD approaches generally suffer from an accuracy drop and/or an excruciatingly long distillation process. In this paper, we tackle the issue by first providing a new insight into a phenomenon that we call the inter-block optimization entanglement (IBOE), which makes the conventional end-to-end KD approaches unstable with noisy gradients.

arxiv-2401-09559.title: Asymptotic online FWER control for dependent test statistics
arxiv-2401-09559.creator: Vincent Jankovic, Lasse Fischer, Werner Brannath
arxiv-2401-09559.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Vincent Jankovic, Lasse Fischer, Werner Brannath. In online multiple testing, an a priori unknown number of hypotheses are tested sequentially, i.e., at each time point, a test decision for the current hypothesis has to be made using only the data available so far. Although many powerful test procedures have been developed for online error control in recent years, most of them are designed solely for independent or at most locally dependent test statistics.

arxiv-2403-10223.title: H α \alpha Time Delays of AGNs from the Zwicky Transcient Facility Broadband Photometry
arxiv-2403-10223.creator: Qinchun Ma, Yuhan Wen, Xue-Bing Wu, Huapeng Gu, Yuming Fu
arxiv-2403-10223.description: Abstract In our previous work on broadband photometric reverberation mapping (PRM), we proposed the ICCF-Cut process to obtain the time lags of H α \alpha emission line from two broadband lightcurves via subtracting the continuum emission from the line band. Extending the work, we enlarge our sample to the Zwicky Transient Facility (ZTF) database.

arxiv-2407-07421.title: Federated PCA on Grassmann Manifold for IoT Anomaly Detection Thanks: T.-A. Nguyen, L. T. Le, N. H. Tran, W. Bao, and S. Seneviratne are with the School of Computer Science, The University of Sydney, Sydney, NSW 2006, Australia (email: tung6100@uni.sydney.edu.au, {long.le, nguyen.tran, wei.bao, sura
arxiv-2407-07421.creator: Tung-Anh Nguyen, Long Tan Le, Tuan Dung Nguyen
arxiv-2407-07421.description: Abstract With the proliferation of the Internet of Things (IoT) and the rising interconnectedness of devices, network security faces significant challenges, especially from anomalous activities. While traditional machine learning-based intrusion detection systems (ML-IDS) effectively employ supervised learning methods, they possess limitations such as the requirement for labeled data and challenges with high dimensionality.

arxiv-2505-24722.title: HELM: Hyperbolic Large Language Models via Mixture-of-Curvature Experts Thanks: Correspondence Author; work done while at Yale University, USA.
arxiv-2505-24722.creator: Neil He ⋆ Rishabh Anand ⋆ Hiren Madhu Ali Maatouk, ⋆ Equal Contribution
arxiv-2505-24722.description: Abstract Frontier large language models (LLMs) have shown great success in text modeling and generation tasks across domains. However, natural language exhibits inherent semantic hierarchies and nuanced geometric structure, which current LLMs do not capture completely owing to their reliance on Euclidean operations such as dot-products and norms.

arxiv-2507-02625.title: The covariance matrix spectrum of correlated charge insulators reveals hidden connections to Coupled Cluster, Matrix Product, and Rokhsar-Kivelson states
arxiv-2507-02625.creator: Izak Snyman, Serge Florens
arxiv-2507-02625.description: Abstract Charge ordering induced by strong short-range repulsion in itinerant fermion systems typically follows a two-sites alternation pattern. However, the covariance matrix spectrum of the one-dimensional, half-filled, spinless t t - V V model reveals a post-Hartree-Fock picture at strong repulsion, with emergent four-site disruptions of the underlying staggered mean-field state.

arxiv-2512-10909.title: Electronic crystals and quasicrystals in semiconductor quantum wells: an AI-powered discovery
arxiv-2512-10909.creator: Filippo Gaggioli, Pierre-Antoine Graham, Liang Fu
arxiv-2512-10909.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Filippo Gaggioli, Pierre-Antoine Graham, Liang Fu. The homogeneous electron gas is a cornerstone of quantum condensed matter physics, providing the foundation for developing density functional theory and understanding electronic phases in semiconductors. However, theoretical understanding of strongly-correlated electrons in realistic semiconductor systems remains limited. In this work, we develop a neural network based variational approach to study quantum wells in three dimensional geometry for a variety of electron densities and well thicknesses.

arxiv-2512-21585.title: Dynamic Data Pricing: A Mean Field Stackelberg Game Approach
arxiv-2512-21585.creator: Lijun Bo, Dongfang Yang, Shihua Wang
arxiv-2512-21585.description: Abstract This paper studies the dynamic pricing mechanism for data products in demand-driven markets through a game-theoretic framework. We develop a three-tier Stackelberg game model to capture the hierarchical strategic interactions among key market entities: a single data buyer, an intermediary broker, and a competitive seller group.

pmc-11282318.title: Advancing insights into microgravity induced muscle changes using Caenorhabditis elegans as a model organism
pmc-11282318.creator: Laura J Beckett, Philip M Williams, Li Shean Toh, Volker Hessel, Lukas Gerstweiler, Ian Fisk, Luis Toronjo-Urquiza, Veeren M Chauhan
pmc-11282318.description: Spaceflight presents significant challenges to the physiological state of living organisms. This can be due to the microgravity environment experienced during long-term space missions, resulting in alterations in muscle structure and function, such as atrophy. However, a comprehensive understanding of the adaptive mechanisms of biological systems is required to devise potential solutions and therapeutic approaches for adapting to spaceflight conditions.

pmc-11428943.title: Mechanisms Linking Social Media Use and Sleep in Emerging Adults in the United States
pmc-11428943.creator: Joshua Ethan Kinsella, Brian N. Chin
pmc-11428943.description: Social media use is associated with poor sleep outcomes. We aimed to extend previous research by examining how measures of social media use would affect two sleep characteristics: sleep quality and insomnia symptoms. In addition, we tested a serial mediation model linking social media use to sleep through increases in negative social comparison and pre-sleep cognitive arousal.

pmc-11640796.title: Technology Innovation for Discovering Renal Autoantibodies in Autoimmune Conditions
pmc-11640796.creator: Maurizio Bruschi, Giovanni Candiano, Andrea Petretto, Andrea Angeletti, Pier Luigi Meroni, Marco Prunotto, Gian Marco Ghiggeri
pmc-11640796.description: Autoimmune glomerulonephritis is a homogeneous area of renal pathology with clinical relevance in terms of its numerical impact and difficulties in its treatment. Systemic lupus erythematosus/lupus nephritis and membranous nephropathy are the two most frequent autoimmune conditions with clinical relevance. They are characterized by glomerular deposition of circulating autoantibodies that recognize glomerular antigens.

pmc-11713575.title: Study entry, change, and death: learning from decades of follow‐up in clinical‐pathologic studie
pmc-11713575.creator: Ana W Capuano, Lisa L Barnes, Julie A Schneider, David A Bennett
pmc-11713575.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundDementia, a growing health crisis, disproportionally affects persons from racial/ethnic backgrounds and individuals with comorbidities. Latelife change in cognition is complex and nonlinear, as well as differential for these individuals. These individuals are also largely underrepresented in clinical trials.

pmc-11727536.title: Fractal Conditional Correlation Dimension Infers Complex Causal Networks
pmc-11727536.creator: Özge Canlı Usta, Erik M Bollt, Alberto Porta
pmc-11727536.description: Determining causal inference has become popular in physical and engineering applications. While the problem has immense challenges, it provides a way to model the complex networks by observing the time series. In this paper, we present the optimal conditional correlation dimensional geometric information flow principle (oGeoC) that can reveal direct and indirect causal relations in a network through geometric interpretations.

pmc-12641925.title: Dentomaxillofacial abnormalities associated with rare bone disease in two pediatric populations from southern Europe and East Africa
pmc-12641925.creator: Lluís Brunet-Llobet, Elias Isaack Mashala, Anastasiya Lapitskaya, Judit Rabassa-Blanco, María Dolores Rocha-Eiroa, Jaume Miranda-Rius
pmc-12641925.description: BackgroundIt is well known that certain bone diseases of congenital origin are associated with dentomaxillofacial (DOMF) disorders. The objective of this study was to evaluate and compare the DOMF alterations in pediatric patients with bone diseases in Arusha (Tanzania, East Africa) and Barcelona (Spain, southern Europe).

pmc-12652055.title: Genomics and Epigenomics Approaches for the Quantification of Circulating Tumor DNA in Liquid Biopsy: Relevance of a Multimodal Strategy
pmc-12652055.creator: Elisa De Paolis, Alessia Perrucci, Gabriele Albertini Petroni, Alessandra Conca, Matteo Corsi, Andrea Urbani, Angelo Minucci, Won Jong Rhee
pmc-12652055.description: The adoption of liquid biopsy approaches in clinical practice has triggered a significant paradigm shift in the diagnostic, prognostic, and predictive outcomes for cancer patients. Circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) is considered a valuable biomarker for monitoring tumor burden and its mutational dynamics. In this context, not all cell-free DNA (cfDNA) molecules are derived from tumor cells.

pmc-12664933.title: Plasma p-tau217 correlates strongly with cerebrospinal fluid Aβ42 and increases over a ten-year period in amyloid-positive, non-demented very old men
pmc-12664933.creator: Elisabeth Hellquist, Shorena Janelidze, Bodil Weidung, Kristin Franzon, Vilmantas Giedraitis, Martin Ingelsson, Divya Bali, Vilma Velickaite, Henrik Zetterberg, Oskar Hansson, Lena Kilander
pmc-12664933.description: BackgroundPlasma phosphorylated tau217 (p-tau217) is a robust biomarker of Alzheimer's disease (AD) pathology. However, its full potential as a dynamic marker has still not been verified in very old persons, i.e., those with the highest incidence of AD.ObjectiveTo examine the cross-sectional and longitudinal associations between plasma p-tau217 concentration and cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) AD biomarkers.

pmc-13166184.title: Neutralizing epitope mapping for deltacoronavirus receptor-binding domain and seroepidemiological survey across different animal species
pmc-13166184.creator: Dexin Li, Liying Hao, Baicheng Huang, Zhiyan Wang, Zenglin Wang, Menghao Guo, Yunjing Zhang, Junhua Deng, Yufang Li, Shaoruo Zhao, Kegong Tian, Xiangdong Li
pmc-13166184.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Porcine deltacoronavirus (PDCoV) is an emerging enteric pathogen that poses a significant threat to the global swine industry and carries a potential public health risk. The development of neutralizing monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) is crucial for preventing and controlling PDCoV. However, research on neutralizing linear epitopes within the PDCoV receptor-binding domain (RBD) and the establishment of serological assays based on such mAbs remains limited. In this study, we generated two neutralizing mAbs, 1C12 and 3A11, targeting the PDCoV RBD.

pmc-13529888.title: Z-selective hydrosilylation of terminal alkynes catalyzed by a bench-stable manganese alkyl complex
pmc-13529888.creator: Daniel P Zobernig, Karl Kirchner
pmc-13529888.description: A stereo- and regioselective Mn(I)-catalyzed hydrosilylation of terminal alkynes is described. The hydrosilylation reaction selectively yields the thermodynamically less stable (Z)-alkenyl silane. A wide variety of aromatic and aliphatic alkynes were efficiently and selectively hydrosilylated. The reactions proceed with catalyst loadings of 1–2 mol% at 60 °C in THF without the need of any additives.

pmc-13563172.title: The Secretome Derived From Human Umbilical Cord Mesenchymal Stem Cells Improves Skin Photoaging by Enhancing Mitophagy to Inhibit the cGAS‐STING Pathway
pmc-13563172.creator: Tingting Tang, Meifen Lin, Jingjing Yang, Xinyu Yang, Xunhong Xu, Xuan Wang, Yarui Zhang, Qimei Chen, Shan Zhao, Chenhui Guo, Hao Zhang, Min Zhang, Lin Zhang, Xueer Wang
pmc-13563172.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Ultraviolet (UV)‐induced skin photoaging is driven by cellular senescence and chronic inflammation. Although the secretome (SCT) derived from human umbilical cord mesenchymal stem cells (hUC‐MSC SCT) exhibits regenerative potential, its role in combating photoaging remains to be elucidated. In this study, we show that SCT markedly ameliorates photoaging in UV‐exposed mice, restoring epidermal barrier function, dermal collagen integrity, senescence‐associated markers, and systemic inflammatory profiles. In UVB‐irradiated human immortalized keratinocytes (HaCaT), SCT enhanced cellular viability, proliferation, and migration while alleviating cellular senescence.

pmc-13589217.title: The Intraplantar CFA Inflammatory Pain Model Incompletely Captures Pain Comorbidities Across Sexes
pmc-13589217.creator: Caitlin E. Fenech, Neda Assareh, Karin R. Aubrey
pmc-13589217.description: In humans, chronic pain is characterized by a combination of heightened nociceptive sensitivity along with emotional comorbidities, with more women impacted than men. A reported limitation of preclinical models is that they often fail to encapsulate this complexity, and few studies have directly compared behavioral outcomes between male and female mice.

uslaw-usc-t15-s6002.title: 15 U.S.C. § 6002 — Purposes for grants
uslaw-usc-t15-s6002.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t15-s6002.description: United States Code, Title 15 (Commerce And Trade); Chapter 86 (Children’S Bicycle Helmet Safety). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. A grant made under section 6001 of this title may be used by a grantee to— (1) enforce a law that requires individuals under the age of 16 to wear approved bicycle helmets on their heads while riding on bicycles; (2) provide assistance.
